edit.description: narrow resolveLastRelease's CHANGELOG.md catch to ENOENT

summary: refuse a non-ENOENT CHANGELOG.md read in the changelog miner's boundary resolution instead of degrading to the tag fallback
acceptance: resolveLastRelease rethrows every CHANGELOG.md read error but ENOENT; absence alone reaches the semver-tag fallback
tests: an unreadable CHANGELOG.md refuses instead of resolving the boundary from the tag fallback
notes: scripts/build-changelog.mjs:67 catches every readFileSync error. The file's own doc block (:12-20) scopes the tag fallback to a repo that never recorded a version, so the catch is wider than its declared trigger. An unreadable CHANGELOG.md silently re-mines already-released build: commits under ## [Unreleased] for a human to curate.
